The [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] '''''Helot''-class medium space transport''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was designed in the time before the resurgence of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]], that had already declined in popularity by the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ship was designed by [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] from both Cygnus Spaceworks and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], and was designed as an affordable ship. The Helot lacked shields and had low maneuverability, but was equipped with fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

By [[137 ABY]], the ''Helot''-class transport had become little more than a memory to many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], however, many were still in use. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] owned a ''Helot''-class medium space transport dubbed the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']].
